subject: Motor Vehicle Zoning Restrictions
overview: The subcommittee met to address concerns regarding the influx of automotive repair shops displaced from neighboring cities into Medford's commercial and industrial districts. The committee approved a motion to draft zoning amendments shifting motor vehicle uses from by-right to special permits and bundling technical corrections to the zoning ordinance for review by the Community Development Board.

items.title: Paper 23-302: Zoning Tools for Smart Growth and Motor Vehicle Uses
items.summary: Approved a motion to draft zoning amendments changing motor vehicle uses from allowed by-right to requiring a special permit, combined with several technical corrections to the zoning recodification, for referral to the Community Development Board.
